thread:
jia: Quick RFC follow-up: reviewed rollout metadata. Question: keep per-tenant pin as opaque string or split into binding + affinity for clearer semantics?
sam: split it. opaque pins hide tenant vs global intent.
matt: splitting increases client surface; will need compatibility shims or schema versioning.
jia: proposal: keep pin string as canonical v1, add optional binding and affinity objects in v2. resolve precedence: binding > pin string > rollout hint.
nina: can ttl move into binding? current pin_ttl is a flat int that leaks ops semantics.
kevin: ttl used by eviction. if in binding, make it nullable and add ttl_policy enum {INHERIT, SOFT, HARD}.
jia: example: { pin: "model:abc123", binding: { scope: "tenant", target: "model:abc123", ttl: 3600, ttl_policy: "SOFT" }, affinity: { weight: 0.8, fallbacks: ["model:abc122","model:abc120"] } }
sam: fallbacks good. enforce deterministic order and cap length.
matt: decide whether affinity is honored only under overload or always; some customers forbid implicit swaps.
nina: UX: add enforcement on binding (REQUIRED, PREFERRED, OPTIONAL). REQUIRED = hard pin, PREFERRED = best-effort, OPTIONAL = advisory.
kevin: if REQUIRED, scheduler must guarantee capacity or reject; control plane needs quota checks.
jia: implementation plan: stage A accept old pin string and new objects with precedence; stage B emit schema_version and validate clients when >= v2; stage C update Console and SDKs.
sam: add compatibility table in RFC with examples (pin-only, binding-only, both).
matt: tradeoff: json api vs protobuf typed internals. maybe keep JSON user-api and protobuf internally once schema_version exists.
nina: agree, internal protobuf buys typed validation without breaking clients.
kevin: telemetry must record resolution path; add resolved_via to rollout traces.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new schema changes must pass CI job rollout-schema-check.
jia: action items: i'll draft v2 schema with enforcement/ttl_policy/affinity + compatibility rules; @sam add examples; @kevin spec quota reactions; @matt list SDK migration notes.
sam: bikeshed: naming binding vs pin_object? binding communicates intent, prefer binding.
matt: +1 binding. add lint rule: fallbacks unique and limited to 5 entries.
nina: i'll mock UI after draft.
jia: thanks all — drafting now. :rocket:
